"""Test harness for sort_list, validating against spec.md."""

from sorting import sort_list


def check(items):
    snapshot = list(items)  # taken before the call, to detect mutation
    result = sort_list(items)
    # Property 1: permutation — same length and same value multiset
    assert len(result) == len(snapshot), f"length changed for {items}"
    assert sorted(result) == sorted(snapshot), f"not a permutation for {items}: {result}"
    # Property 2: non-decreasing order
    assert all(result[i] <= result[i + 1] for i in range(len(result) - 1)), (
        f"not sorted for {items}: {result}"
    )
    # Purity: input list unchanged
    assert items == snapshot, f"input mutated for {items}"
    return result


def main():
    cases = [
        [],                      # empty list
        [42],                    # single element
        [3, 1, 2],               # general case
        [5, 5, 1, 5, 1],         # duplicates
        [4, 4, 4],               # all equal
        [3, -1, 0, -1],          # duplicates with negatives
        [5, 4, 3, 2, 1],         # reverse sorted
        [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],         # already sorted
    ]
    for items in cases:
        result = check(items)
        print(f"sort_list({items!r}) -> {result!r}  OK")
    print("All tests passed.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
